title: Bracelet
description: Amulets that can summon fire and allow you to fly.
body:
**_Welcome to  Bracelet!_**

**_Amulets:_**



**Fire Amulet:**

When the special ability is used it summon a line of fire in every direction around the player (East, West, South and North)



**Water Amulet:**

When the special ability is used it summon water in a 7x7x7 area around the player



**Tank Amulet:**

When the special ability is used it gives you tanks effects like that you get slower but you have way more health and deal more damage



**Lightning Amulet:**

When the special ability is used it you get the power to summon lightning



**God Amulet:**

When the special ability is used it gives you the God Sword for a few seconds



**Cloud Amulet:**

When the special ability is used it you activate your cloud form



**_Amulet items:_**



**God Sword:**

When you have this sword in your inventory you get speed and become imortal as long as it stays in your inventory



**Cloud form:**

You become faster and lighter but become weak and break blocks slower



**Lightning Summoner:**

You use it to summon lightning when the Lightning Amulet ability is enabled
